profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at BambooHR
profile.summary: Front-end expert with back-end chops. Experienced in development using modern technologies including React, Vue, Node, Laravel, MYSQL, PostgreSQL, and GraphQL.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Cottonwood Heights, Utah, United States · Remote
positions.description:
* Leading frontend engineer for venture captial analytics applicaiton.
* Uses React, NextJS, Nx, Vercel, CircleCi, Jest, Cypress, PostgreSQL, Ruby on Rails, and CodeCov.
* Integral in the development of feature that was key in resigning important client.
* Mentors other developers one-on-one, through code review, and department presentations.
* Engages in the process of creating and adopting new department standards.
* Consistently engineers accessible components and utilities for features that positively affect developer productivity department-wide.
* Regularly collaborates with design and product on road mapping deliverables.
* Identifies and develops solutions for inefficient parts of our application.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Key full stack developer of a CI/CD Agile team responsible for writing test-driven code for fintech borrower application.
•	Used NodeJS, VueJS, NuxtJS, ExpressJS, Laravel, MySQL, Bootstrap 5, nginx, Docker, Docker Compose, Cypress, Bash, Git, Linux CLI, Jira, AVA, Adobe Target, Okta, Github Actions, Rollbar.
•	Lead development on updating company borrower application to use component-driven, modern, and mobile-friendly design with adherence to frontend best practices.
•	Heavily involved in the transition and education of the developer organization in using Docker/Docker Compose for developer environments.
•	Regularly involved in the development of onboarding documentation and tooling in assisting devs creation of a stable development environment.

positions.title: Web Developer 2
positions.description:
•	Member of Agile team that writes test-driven code responsible for global and localized support of search feature.
•	Used NodeJS, ReactJS, React Hooks, Native Web Components, GraphQL, REST, Jest, React Testing Library, Karma, CodeClimate, Heroku, Splunk, Sentry, Git, Linux CLI, Version One.
•	Worked with organization architecture and administration in obtaining approval for technologies and practices related to team features.
•	Regularly assisted with fixing production issues and monitoring application performance.
•	Mentored intern and level 1 developers in understanding new technologies and team practices.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
• Coordinated with senior developer and CTO in creating new company admin site.
• Used Laravel, Docker, VueJS, PostgreSQL, REST, CSS, SASS, SCSS, Git, Linux CLI and Jira.
• Created VueJS, single-page-application, front-end environment.
• Installed and supported Laravel MVC back-end API.
• Created single, relational, PostgreSQL database solution from two existing MySQL databases without relations.
• Worked with Google Ads, Salesforce, PandaDocs, and VWO APIs.
• Mentored junior developer on use of frameworks, MVC, and other best practices.

positions.title: Software Developer II, Full Stack
positions.description:
•	Member of Agile development team responsible for company logistics software.
•	Used Laravel, Cake PHP, JavaScript, jQuery, AJAX, CSS, MySQL, AWS, Git, and Linux CLI in development.
•	Coordinated with clients to launch and support new features for company warehouses.
•	Facilitated development of essential functions for the launch of company promotions.
•	Integrated software to work with external systems through RESTful solutions.
•	Regularly resolved production support issues.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Lead development for the Oxford Guide to Classical Mythology in the Arts or the OGCMA
•	Created a MySQL database-driven website designed to hold the content of an Oxford University text.
•	Held frequent meetings to establish client expectations and report progress.
•	Developed web applications for separate parts of the website.
•	Instructed interns from the Office of Digital Humanities of BYU.

company.name: BYU Comparative Arts and Letters Department

positions.title: Web Development Teaching Assitant
positions.description:
•	Assisted in the instruction of the course content for basic front-end and back-end programming.
•	Taught HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP and MySQL.
•	Provided instruction outside of class for course students seeking additional assistance.
•	Worked with all kinds of students that required being aware of students’ individual progression and needs.
•	Helped troubleshoot and proofread up to forty students’ code throughout a semester.
